SELECT b.* FROM t_book b
b.deleted = 0 AND b.status = 1
AND b.category_id = #{categoryId}

ORDER BY (title LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%')) DESC, (author LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%')) DESC, rate DESC, sales DESC LIMIT #{limit}
